title: 矽上量子點雷射研究
summary: 從量子點增益、異質磊晶缺陷與長期穩定性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate quantum-dot gain, heteroepitaxial defects and long-term stability, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 材料與增益
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「材料與增益」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Materials and gain through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 量子點與量子井：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Dots versus wells: model and design
steps.objective: 以「量子點與量子井」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for dots versus wells, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「量子點與量子井」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。三維載子侷限改變能態分布；量子點並不自動消除所有非輻射復合。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for dots versus wells, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Three-dimensional confinement changes the density of states; dots do not automatically remove nonradiative recombination. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。
steps.observationEn: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：量子點會消除所有位錯造成的復合。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Quantum dots eliminate all dislocation-related recombination. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交量子點與量子井的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for dots versus wells, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「矽上量子點雷射研究」的「量子點與量子井：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光引擎：把訊號接回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Dots versus wells: model and design” in “Quantum-dot lasers on silicon research”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Engine: Restore the Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 要審查「量子點與量子井」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing dots versus wells?
options: 三維載子侷限改變能態分布；量子點並不自動消除所有非輻射復合。
量子點會消除所有位錯造成的復合。
短期沒有失效即可保證多年壽命。
optionsEn: Three-dimensional confinement changes the density of states; dots do not automatically remove nonradiative recombination.
Quantum dots eliminate all dislocation-related recombination.
A short failure-free run guarantees years of life.
quiz.explanation: 三維載子侷限改變能態分布；量子點並不自動消除所有非輻射復合。 比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。
quiz.explanationEn: Three-dimensional confinement changes the density of states; dots do not automatically remove nonradiative recombination. Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: A short failure-free run guarantees years of life. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交量子點與量子井的量測判別表：比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for threshold current density, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「閾值電流密度」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。閾值電流密度由電流除以明確定義的注入面積，不能混用脊寬與光模態寬。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「按算例換算 cm² 面積，並比較單顆與陣列面積定義。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設閾值電流 30 mA，注入面積 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm²，Jth=1000 A/cm²。若誤以 6 μm 寬換算，會得 500 A/cm²；差別來自定義，並非元件改進。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for threshold current density, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Threshold current density uses a defined injection area, not an interchangeable ridge or optical-mode width. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Convert area to cm² in the example and compare single-device and array area definitions. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume threshold current 30 mA and injection area 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm², giving Jth=1000 A/cm². Using 6 μm width instead gives 500 A/cm²; that difference is a definition error, not device improvement.

steps.title: 閾值電流密度：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Threshold current density: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「閾值電流密度」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for threshold current density, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。按算例換算 cm² 面積，並比較單顆與陣列面積定義。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「閾值電流密度由電流除以明確定義的注入面積，不能混用脊寬與光模態寬。」與錯誤假說「量子點會消除所有位錯造成的復合。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設閾值電流 30 mA，注入面積 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm²，Jth=1000 A/cm²。若誤以 6 μm 寬換算，會得 500 A/cm²；差別來自定義，並非元件改進。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Convert area to cm² in the example and compare single-device and array area definitions. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Threshold current density uses a defined injection area, not an interchangeable ridge or optical-mode width." against the incorrect hypothesis "Quantum dots eliminate all dislocation-related recombination."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume threshold current 30 mA and injection area 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm², giving Jth=1000 A/cm². Using 6 μm width instead gives 500 A/cm²; that difference is a definition error, not device improvement.
steps.observation: 按算例換算 cm² 面積，並比較單顆與陣列面積定義。

steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：量子點會消除所有位錯造成的復合。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Quantum dots eliminate all dislocation-related recombination. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交閾值電流密度的量測判別表：按算例換算 cm² 面積，並比較單顆與陣列面積定義。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
